newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Partners LP said Monday it has acquired a 5.6 percent stake or 453,900 common shares in Pacific Sunwear of California Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based group said its stake includes a net of 52,600 shares of the company bought between November 1 and January 2 at prices ranging from $21.25 to $26.625 a share.
The group said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
Pacific Sunwear is an Anaheim, Calif.,-based speciality retailer of casual appareal, accessories and footwear for teen-agers and young adults.
